description: Returns a list of all workflow managers for a given project and tool.

parameters.name: tool_type
parameters.description: Workflow-enabled tool to return workflow managers for (for example, `subcontract_invoice`).

parameters.name: tool_subtype
parameters.description: For correspondence, the correspondence type's domain id. Required when tool_type is 'correspondence'. For a tool that passes the workflow template subtype to its permissions adapter, the template s...

parameters.name: filters[search]
parameters.description: Case-insensitive filter on the workflow manager's name. Matches a partial value against the first name, the last name, or the full name, so "jane d" matches "Jane Doe".

id.description: Unique identifier for the workflow manager

company.description: Vendor company for the workflow manager when one is associated in the requested company context
